title: nora-patel-sdk-docs-scratchpad
content:
2026-03-03 - SDK docs scratchpad (worklog)
Owner: Nora Patel
Team: developer-experience
Status: draft

High-level goals:
- Close doc gaps for v0.9 SDK release (primarily Python + JS quickstarts).
- Add two sample apps: chat-widget and vector-search-demo.
- Fix tutorial steps that break on latest CLI (auth flow + streaming).

Today / immediate TODOs:
- [ ] Audit Python quickstart for new 'client.route' API (issue: streaming example still uses legacy call). (Owner: Nora)
- [ ] Add note about timeout defaults in JS SDK (users hitting 120s; need guidance). (Owner: Alex)
- [ ] Create minimal chat-widget sample (React + Redwood hosted API): scaffold + README + deploy notes. (Owner: Priya)
- [ ] Add troubleshooting subsection: common auth errors (401 from missing scope), KMS hint for Private deployments. (Owner: Nora)
- [ ] Sync with infra on sample API key rotation cadence (blocked). (Req: @infra on Slack)

Notes / Findings:
- Streaming example broken after CLI v1.4. They removed 'streamResponse' flag; need to switch to 'client.stream()' pattern. Spot in docs: quickstarts/python.md and examples/streaming-chat.md.
- JS quickstart uses fetch polyfill recommendation that conflicts with Next.js edge runtime. Add an alternative snippet for Edge.
- Embeddings sample currently stores the vectors in a mock array; we should add an example using a simple SQLite vector table + query snippet (keeps it local and reproducible).
- Sample app deps are heavy (torch etc.) — for sample apps use hosted API by default, but include optional self-hosted notes in a separate doc.

Unresolved questions / decisions:
- Do we keep the legacy 'client.generate' example in quickstart or replace entirely? (Backward compatibility vs beginner clarity)
- Should we provide a single monorepo for all samples or separate repos per sample app? (Preference: single monorepo with top-level README and per-sample READMEs)

Bugs & small fixes to file tickets for:
- CLI streaming example mismatch (LINEAR-556) -- needs small code patch and doc update.
- JS timeout default unclear -> cause support churn (file: docs/js/timeouts.md).
- Embeddings sample: missing filter example for vector search (add top-k + metadata filter snippet).

Proposed micro tasks (quick wins):
- 30m: update Python quickstart streaming snippet (replace legacy flag).
- 45m: add Edge-runtime note in JS quickstart (copy/paste snippet).
- 1h: add troubleshooting/401 section + KMS pointer.

Links / refs:
- GH PR with initial snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/342
- Confluence planning doc: CONFLUENCE-DEVX-128
- Related linear ticket: LINEAR-556
- Slack: #dev-docs thread (ts:1678901234)

Next syncs:
- Weekly triage with Alex + Priya on Mon 10:00 PT (add agenda: prioritize sample apps, assign owners).
- Sync with infra once sample auth flow is nailed down (blocked until Claire confirms key rotation).

Notes to self:
- Keep examples minimal and copy-paste ready — avoid heavy ML deps.
- Add 'expected costs' callout for hosted API in sample READMEs so devs are not surprised.
- When updating the quickstart, run the CI playground tests (docs smoke tests) before merging.

Random TODOs (parking lot):
- Add a 'how we measure success' checklist for each sample (e.g., can run locally in <= 10 mins, has CI, has README with expected outputs).
- Consider adding a short video screencast for chat-widget sample (screencast notes: 3–4 min).

-- Nora
